Uses of Class
jaba.Hull.Vertex

Packages that use Vertex
Package
Description
jaba
The JABA tool: identification of bottlenecks in multiclass closed product form networks using efficient convex hull algorithms, as described in the user manual.
jaba.Hull
Two dimensional convex hull algorithms used by JABA to build the characteristic polytope of the model.
